review_scope: Technical feasibility and interface audit only. Not production, not Gate A approval.

findings.observation: No real generator capability evidence. Synthetic PNG QA does not prove RGBA/single-subject/shape controllability.
findings.probe: Run a bounded non-animal synthetic-object probe with real target generator using small predeclared sample set; decode actual returned bytes; compare source and hashes; one retry per failure category maximum; no universal guarantee.

findings.observation: Text/JSON repository handoff proven; binary upload via available GitHub connector not tested.
findings.recommended_channel: GitHub blob base64 upload or GitHub Contents API with verified binary bytes; no text encoding of raw PNG as UTF-8; alternatively artifact/file storage with both roles read+write verified.
binary_contract: SHA256 computed on exact original binary bytes and compared after independent download
PNG magic bytes, IHDR dimensions, RGBA decode, alpha statistics
file existence is not delivery until receiving role independently downloads and validates
findings.probe: Create one tiny procedurally generated RGBA PNG, upload as true binary via allowed connector/API, fetch exact bytes in a separate work page and compare SHA-256; record artifact commit and both receipts. If connector cannot handle bytes, mark BINARY_TRANSPORT_BLOCKED and select alternative storage. No animals.

minimal_plan: No multi-adapter platform; probe first available capable generator, prefer native alpha if actual output proves it
Only if probe fails and within explicit budget, evaluate simple neutral background plus one general-purpose cutout route
Keep same output/QA schema and bounded retries; stop if repeated source failures; never species-specific hacks
Do not set cell_px/engine render profile before product decision; use EXPERIMENT outputs until frozen
findings.seven_day_rule: Seven days covers whole releasable first game, not a technical prototype. Gate A alone does not authorize pipeline expansion.

findings.sequence: T1/T2 ART candidate → T3 DEV G1/G2 preliminary technical preflight → T4 ART/user G3 candidate version approval → T5 DEV integration and real G4 → release gates. G4 not prerequisite to G3; G3 not evidence of G4.
